summary: Alibaba Model Studio currently exposes Qwen3.7 Plus and Qwen3.7 Flash; both were absent from canonical models. Exact stable release dates were not inferred from dated aliases.
StepFun pricing currently lists Step 3.7 Flash and Step 3.5 Flash; both were absent from canonical models.
Kimi API surfaces currently expose Kimi K2.7 Code, K2.7 Code Highspeed and K2.6 in addition to K3; these API models were absent from canonical models.
Kimi documentation states platform access for Kimi K2.5 and moonshot-v1 will fully shut down on 2026-08-31 after new-user access had already stopped.
Backfill: Google released Gemini Robotics-ER 2.0 Preview and its streaming preview on 2026-07-30; they were missing from canonical models.
Google Gemini API changelog schedules Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6 Preview shutdown for 2026-08-31.
Anthropic states Claude Sonnet 5 pricing of $2/M input and $10/M output is now standard; the previously scheduled 2026-09-01 increase to $3/$15 will not occur.
Anthropic retired the legacy Workbench and three experimental prompt APIs on 2026-08-17; no Claude model was retired by this entry.

OVHcloud's lifecycle table currently schedules Qwen3-32B for decommission on 2026-09-16; Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 and Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-FP8 on 2026-10-01; Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407 and Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506 on 2026-11-04.
Cerebras currently exposes GPT-OSS 120B in production and Gemma 4 31B plus GLM-4.7 in preview/provider availability; these model IDs were absent from the canonical model inventory.
Tencent Cloud TokenHub currently lists Hy3 in its official model/pricing surface; it was absent from canonical models.
Official Volcengine recovery surfaces current Doubao-Seed-Evolving, Doubao-Seed-2.1-Pro and Doubao-Seed-2.1-Turbo model/pricing identifiers; they were absent from canonical models.
NVIDIA's current free serverless API catalog features Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B A55B and Thinking Machines Inkling among current entries; both were absent from canonical models.

The previously canonical DeepSeek V4 Flash/Pro peak/off-peak pricing structure became effective on 2026-08-16 16:00 UTC; current pricing records are appended while preserving the earlier upcoming records.
Backfill: Anthropic has offered Claude Mythos 5 in limited Project Glasswing availability since 2026-06-09; it was missing from canonical models.
Alibaba Model Studio currently lists qwen3.8-max in the official model catalog and pricing surface; the exact stable release date was not established in the checked primary sources.
Z.ai documentation marks GLM-5.3 as its latest flagship and makes it available to all GLM Coding Plan users; the public API is stated as coming soon.
OpenAI's current API pricing documentation lists gpt-5.6-cyber in the Daybreak cyber-model section; it was missing from canonical models.
Backfill: Google will shut down imagen-4.0-generate-001, imagen-4.0-ultra-generate-001 and imagen-4.0-fast-generate-001 on 2026-08-17.

OpenAI's current API platform headline rates show GPT-5.6 Terra at $2/M input and $12/M output and GPT-5.6 Luna at $0.20/M input and $1.20/M output, below the Observatory's prior canonical headline observations.
Observatory adds deterministic exhaustive model-catalog harvesting for OpenRouter and Kilo, including current free variants and router-listed pricing.
Google applies introductory Standard pricing of $0.75/M input and $3.75/M output to Gemini 3.7 Flash and 3.6 Flash through 2026-12-31; standard $1.50/$7.50 rates begin 2027-01-01.
Google released Gemini 3.7 Flash GA on 2026-08-13. Observatory detection was backfilled on 2026-08-15 after the scheduled run missed the release.
Backfill: Google released Gemini 3.6 Flash GA on 2026-07-21; the release had not been captured by the initial Observatory source set.
Backfill: Google released Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite GA on 2026-07-21; the release had not been captured by the initial Observatory source set.
Official DigitalOcean Inference pricing documentation was verified and added as a primary source.
xAI reports Grok 4.6 became available in GitHub Copilot on 2026-08-14.
DeepSeek announces peak/off-peak price structure effective 2026-08-16 16:00 UTC; future record preserved separately from current state.
Cerebras schedules Z.ai GLM 4.7 public endpoint deprecation for 2026-08-17.
MiniMax Token Plan invitation promotion offers 10% invitee discount through 2026-08-31.
Tencent TokenHub pricing source added to registry; current page updated 2026-08-14.
Alibaba Model Studio pricing source reports an update dated 2026-08-13.
